_about: The runs of the Jude-02A GPU experiment. Nothing here has been run. VRAM figures are ARITHMETIC ESTIMATES of weight size (parameters x bits / 8), not measurements, and exclude the KV cache and runtime overhead.

runs.why: smallest candidate; the model card says it fits 24 GB in FP8
same model with room for a larger KV cache: isolates the effect of VRAM on concurrency
mid-size candidate with an official 8-bit build
largest candidate, quantisation-aware trained; card claims 140+ pre-training languages
only if a community 4-bit build is rejected; the card says ~55 GB in bf16, which does not fit 48 GB

quality_gate: A quantised model is only acceptable if its Jude-02A benchmark scores (evaluate.py against the same endpoint) and its human-rubric scores are not worse than the same model served unquantised through OpenRouter.
